column2: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS bucket, MAX(usage_user) AS max_usage_user FROM cpu WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-02 00:00:00' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT t.hostname, DATE_TRUNC('hour', m.created_at) AS bucket, AVG(m.used_percent) AS avg_used_percent FROM mem AS m JOIN tags AS t ON m.tags_id = t.id WHERE m.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND m.created_at < '2026-01-02 00:00:00' GROUP BY t.hostname, bucket ORDER BY t.hostname, bucket;

SELECT t.hostname, m.created_at, m.used_percent FROM mem AS m JOIN tags AS t ON m.tags_id = t.id WHERE m.used_percent > 90 AND m.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND m.created_at < '2026-01-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY m.created_at, t.hostname;

SELECT tags_id, created_at, usage_user FROM (SELECT tags_id, created_at, usage_user, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM cpu) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY tags_id;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', created_at) AS bucket, MAX(used_percent) AS max_used_percent FROM disk WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-02 00:00:00' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket DESC LIMIT 5;
